messages:
Nina: Heads-up — we need a hotfix for 1.9.x shipped today for the token-cache race (503s under burst). Minimal diffs only. Branch freeze at 18:00 UTC. Who can own the changelog PR and confirm QA by 16:30?
Kevin: I can cut the cherry-picks and open the patch branch. Will try to keep diffs tiny.
Kevin: plan:
```
git checkout -b hotfix/1.9.8
git cherry-pick aa11bbcc  # fix token cache race
git cherry-pick dd22eeff  # perf tweak (small)
git push origin hotfix/1.9.8
```
Devon: CI is flaky this morning, saw windows-compat e2e timeout. I'll rerun failing job and patch tests ASAP. @ci-bot please rerun job 1257.
ci-bot: Rerun requested for job 1257. Queueing; will post status.
Sara: I can draft the changelog entry and open a PR. Need the customer-facing blurb — Nina, what should we say exactly?
Nina: Short: "Fix token caching race that could cause 503s under high concurrency; improves stability for bursty inference workloads." Add a rollback note: revert to v1.9.7 if regressions.
Raj: Remind me — what's our rollback procedure if the patch causes issues in prod? Do we need infra help to rollback tag + deploy?
Nina: Rollback plan: revert the tag and promote v1.9.7 via the deploy script. Steps in the runbook under #incidents-runbook. No DB schema changes. If needed, infra will expedite runner allocation. I'll be release owner.
release-bot: When PR merges to main-hotfix, tag v1.9.8 will be created and the release pipeline will trigger.
Sara: Drafted changelog PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/repo/pull/3478 (WIP) — pinging reviewers @kevin @devon.
Kevin: Will review changelog now. Reminder: last cherry-pick cutoff 17:30 UTC to let CI finish before freeze at 18:00. Anything after that has to wait for next stable.
Devon: Found the flaky test, pushed a tiny test-fix to hotfix/1.9.8. Rerunning whole matrix now.
ci-bot: Build passed on linux-x64, flaky-windows job rerun succeeded. All required checks green.
Nina: Good. @release-bot please set the release window to 18:15 UTC if everything stays green so we can do a quick smoke and then cut. :shipit:
Kevin: Notifying infra to prioritize runners between 17:30-18:30.
Sara: Changelog PR updated and marked ready. PR #3478 — link in thread.
Raj: Oncall is aware and watching post-release for 2 hours.
Nina: Thanks everyone. I'll handle the merge + tag at 18:15 if CI stays green. Announcing in #general when live. :partyparrot:
